title: Retain bounded source-owned KDE partial storage under the existing chunked fold
quality_gates: public semantics and canonical tie order retained
NVIDIA+AMD combined faster and neither materially slower
Current numerical profile unchanged in pool baseline/candidate; partials and logweights recompute on every call
Actual resident score_samples pool allocation/reuse/source-key counters and every density bit must pass for supported metrics
Small/large/small budget bound, malformed source descriptor, foreign-key refusal, in-flight refusal, explicit rebind invalidation, release and closed-pool gates must pass
An atomic lease protects retained scratch across released-GIL callers; overlap falls back to original temporaries and exact scores rather than overwriting the pool
timing_contract: Frozen source; compile once on cheap boxes; device runs only; full public-operation timing includes all scratch/preparation/readback. Apple IDENTICAL bit check only. Native builds explicitly bind device column and accelerator; independent host replay remains a separate identity gate, not a DeviceContext execution vendor.
